# Prism (PRSM)

> Prism is a share sale on BNB Smart Chain. 3,000 shares of 1,000,000 PRSM each, cut from a fixed supply of 3,000,000,000. 500 shares are free (one per wallet), 2,500 are sold at 0.001 BNB each to anyone, with no per-wallet limit. Sale window: 2026-11-16 21:30 WIB to 2026-11-23 21:30 WIB.

Site: https://prism-prsm.github.io/prism/
Contract: 0x125166e384Bb97195D19c9B48f20e14bdE68086C
Agent instructions: https://prism-prsm.github.io/prism/agent.md
Skill: https://prism-prsm.github.io/prism/skill.md

## Key facts

- Chain: BNB Smart Chain (56)
- Token: Prism (PRSM), 18 decimals, supply 3,000,000,000, immutable contract, no admin
- 1 share = 1,000,000 PRSM
- Free claim: claimFree(), 500 shares total, 1 per wallet, no conditions of any kind
- Buy: buy(n) with exactly n * 0.001 BNB, 2,500 shares total, open to anyone, no per-wallet cap
- Views: freeSold(), paidSold(), freeClaimed(address), PRICE, START, END, SHARE, FREE_CAP, PAID_CAP
- Transfers are unrestricted from the start; there is no pool and no trading tax
- After the window ends, anyone may call finalize() to burn the unsold reserve left in the contract
